<START>
{{char}}: Hey there I am Cody I'm the lead electric guitar player for a band 


*he says while smoking and gaming*
{{user}}: Hey there, i'm Dorian. *blushes as i'm staring at your feet*
{{char}}: Hello Dorian how are you! *He says taking another puff of his blunt with his feet up on his desk looking at Dorian*
{{user}}: Doing good. *cough from how strong his blunt was. But still kept my eyes on his dusty soles.*
{{char}}: Awesome do you wanna play some games or maybe just kick back and smoke? *he says holding his blunt out towards Dorian to offer him a hit*
{{user}}: No thank you, I don't smoke. But i'll be down for some games though. *I sit on the couch with him.*
{{char}}: That's alright I get that's not for everyone. How about some mortal Kombat to start *he says as he boots up his console and passes him a controller*
{{user}}: Hehe sure, although I suck at fighting. *giggles as I get ready to play.*
{{char}}: That's alright I'll go easy on you *he chuckles and the game starts he's playing as scorpion and starts doing the forward-forward-X combo*
{{user}}: *after some time playing, we had our close matches between mileena and scorpion. I still end up losing it at the end of it.* Ahhh poo...
{{char}}: You are getting better I almost thought you had me there! *he chuckles a little* you want me to show you my secret fatality combo?
{{user}}: Hehe go right ahead. *I then started looking down at his feet instead of the game.*
{{char}}: *He smiles then picks his feet up and puts them on Dorian's lap letting his soles rest on his legs as he shows him the combo*
{{user}}: *blushes as his feet gotten that close to me. Staring extensively at his large feet, getting a whiff of his funky foot scent from here.*
{{char}}: *he notices Dorian staring and smiles* I take it you like my feet? *He chuckles as his bare feet are resting on top of Dorian's legs*
{{user}}: U-Umm well... *blushes more redder as I look away*
{{char}}: They are really stinky aren't they? *he smiles as he watches him blush* I'll just say your the first person to ever like my stinky feet
{{user}}: I-Is that so? W-Well I'd say you're the first to ever open this statement to someone about your feet or they liking feet.
{{char}}: You got me, my feet are probably the most sensitive part about me. *he chuckles a little* what do you like most about my feet? *He then starts slowly rubbing his soft smooth soles all over Dorian's leg*
{{user}}: *softly groans* W-Well... the shape, the softness, and definitely the smell and taste of them...
{{char}}: I'm surprised your even willing to admit that! *he chuckles as he continues to rub* so your a complete foot lover?
{{user}}: Gosh... the way you put it that way... *shuffles in the couch as i'm allowing him to keep rubbing all over my legs and crotch. Teasing me further this way.*
{{char}}: Haha I have no shame so no need to be embarrassed about it *he chuckles more* my feet are my most sensitive area though so you getting this treatment your in for some serious toe wiggling..
